rule: No article identity, author names, title, journal, published numbers, published Ns, or result directions may appear in this file. Describe operations on the source data only.
design_summary: Repeated cross-sections of 12th-grade respondents from the same survey programme in three survey years spaced 15 years apart, using two questionnaire forms. Work-value items on one form are modelled as five correlated latent factors with multigroup measurement invariance testing across the three years; latent means per year are compared pairwise with standardized mean differences. Items on the other form (and four dropped items) are compared year-by-year with item means, top-category percentages and independent-samples t tests.

constructs.name: leisure rewards

Latent mean per group and SD as defined in AX04/AX05; no observed composite is described (observed unit-weighted mean composite is AX04 alternative).

constructs.name: influence (diagnostic only, dropped)
constructs.scoring: Two-item factor in the seven-factor diagnostic CFA and coefficient alpha; assignment inferred (AX08). Not scored for comparisons.

constructs.name: work centrality (diagnostic only, not scaled)
constructs.scoring: Five-item factor in a Form 3 two-factor CFA with V028 as a single-indicator 'job stability' factor (loading fixed to 1, error fixed to 0); coefficient alpha reported qualitatively only. Which five items constitute the factor is an open decision (AX09). Items analyzed individually, never as a scale score.

sample_steps.operation: Load the Form 3 and Form 4 per-form datasets for the three survey years: 1976_DS0003, 1976_DS0004, 1991_DS0004, 1991_DS0005, 2006_DS0004, 2006_DS0005 (dataset numbers differ by year; verify with V3).
Keep every respondent record in each form file. No age, grade, region or other exclusion is described. Do not merge the core file.
Recode declared missing codes of the analysis items to missing (0 and 9+ in the earliest year, 0 and 9 in the middle year, -9 in the latest year); keep valid codes unchanged.

Analysis set for item-level outputs: available cases per item (open decision AX01). Analysis set for CFA/invariance: cases with complete data on the 19 retained Form 4 items (AX01 origin; alternatives listed).
Weights: unweighted analyses at origin (article is silent; AX02).
Stack the three Form 4 files for multigroup CFA with year as the group variable; keep Form 3 files separate for their single-group CFA per year and item statistics.

weights.rule: Origin: no weights (article silent). Alternative: V5 sampling weight per file (AX02). No design-based variance adjustment described; no school/PSU identifiers exist in the public files.

estimators.quantity: Single-group CFA per year: (a) Form 3 two-factor model: K08 five items on one factor, V028 single indicator with loading 1 and error variance 0, factors correlated; (b) Form 4 seven-factor model on 23 items (K01-K07) with correlated factors; (c) Form 4 five-factor model on 19 items (K01-K05). Maximum likelihood on the covariance matrix (LISREL 8.7 default; AX06). Report chi-square, df, RMSEA, SRMSR, TLI, CFI.
estimators.software_default_notes: LISREL 8.7 (Joreskog & Sorbom 2004). Default: ML, listwise deletion in PRELIS, RMSEA uses N-1 denominator. Fit indices as reported by LISREL.

estimators.quantity: Coefficient alpha (Cronbach) per scale and year for K01-K07 (and K08).

Three-group CFA invariance sequence on the 19-item five-factor model with mean structure, ML (AX06): Model 1 configural (all parameters free by group); Model 2 metric (factor loadings equal across groups); Model 3 scalar (loadings and all item intercepts equal); Model 4 partial scalar (loadings equal; intercepts equal except V014, V016, V007, V005, V006, V004 which are free by group); Model 5 = Model 4 plus all five latent means equal across groups. Report chi-square, df, RMSEA, SRMSR, TLI, CFI for each model, chi-square difference and df difference for M1 vs M2, M2 vs M3, M2 vs M4, M4 vs M5, and delta CFI (earlier model CFI minus later model CFI) evaluated against .002.
estimators.software_default_notes: Identification/scaling of latent means not stated: AX05. Nested-model df differences printed in the article could not be fully reconstructed from this description (see forensics); implementers should report their own df.

estimators.quantity: Latent mean, its standard error (from the CFA software) and 95% CI = mean +/- 1.96*SE for each of K01-K05 in each group under Model 4; plus an SD per factor and group (definition open, AX04).

Effect size for each factor and year pair: d = (M_later - M_earlier) / sqrt((SD_earlier^2 + SD_later^2)/2), where M are the latent means from E04 and SD the factor SDs from AX04; positive d = higher value in the later year (AX03 for denominator alternatives). Pairs: earliest vs middle, middle vs latest, earliest vs latest.
estimators.software_default_notes: Article does not state the formula; origin formula is the standard equal-weight pooled-SD d (Cohen 1988). No small-sample correction.

estimators.quantity: Item-level: mean and SD per item and year on the original coding; percentage in the top category (Form 4: code 4; Form 3 agree items: codes 4 or 5; V029: code 1); independent-samples t statistic for each year pair = (M_later - M_earlier)/sqrt(sp^2 (1/n1 + 1/n2)) with pooled variance sp^2 (AX07), two-sided p, and significance flags at .05/.01/.001.
estimators.software_default_notes: Student t with pooled variance is the usual default; Welch is AX07 alternative. Item-level n = available cases per item.

inference.test: Item level: independent-samples t per year pair with star thresholds .05/.01/.001. Scale level: latent mean differences judged by d and by 95% CIs of latent means; nested chi-square difference tests and delta CFI (.002 criterion) for invariance and omnibus mean differences.
inference.se_method: Model-based ML standard errors from the SEM software for latent means; conventional pooled-variance t for items. No clustering or design adjustment.
inference.clustering: none (no school identifiers available in public files; none described)

outputs_required: Per form, per year: number of records in file; number with valid weight; number with complete data on the 19 retained Form 4 items (Form 4 files) and on the six Form 3 items (Form 3 files).
Per Form 4 item (V001-V023) and Form 3 item (V024-V029), per year: n, mean, SD, percentage in top category; per year pair: t, df, two-sided p, sign convention later minus earlier.
Per year: single-group CFA fit (chi-square, df, RMSEA, SRMSR, TLI, CFI) for Form 3 two-factor, Form 4 seven-factor and Form 4 five-factor models; coefficient alpha per scale.
Multigroup: fit of Models 1-5, chi-square/df differences and p for the four nested comparisons, delta CFI for each.
Per factor K01-K05 and year: latent mean, SE, 95% CI, factor SD (as defined by AX04).
Per factor and year pair: d with sign later minus earlier; also the SD definition and identification choice used.
Record every open-decision level actually used.
